description: This file defines an interface and a class implementation for securely storing session tokens in an Android application. The interface, TokenStore, declares suspend functions for saving, loading, clearing, and checking for tokens. The class EncryptedPrefsTokenStore provides a concrete implementation backed by Android's EncryptedSharedPreferences, utilizing the Android Keystore via MasterKey for encryption.

classes.name: TokenStore
classes.description: An interface for secure storage of authentication tokens, designed to be UI-agnostic.

classes.name: EncryptedPrefsTokenStore
classes.description: A class that implements TokenStore, storing tokens securely using Android's EncryptedSharedPreferences and Keystore.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists session tokens securely into encrypted preferences.

methods.name: loadOrNull
methods.description: Loads session tokens if available; returns null if not present or on failure.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored tokens from preferences.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of EncryptedPrefsTokenStore with application context.
